title: Barefoot On 30a | Stay On 30a – Luxury Beach Homes In 30a Florida
description_expanded: Welcome to Barefoot on 30a, your private coastal escape tucked perfectly between Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach in the charming Seacrest Beach community. This beautiful three-story home offers the ideal blend of luxury and relaxation, featuring a private pool, spacious interiors, and thoughtful details throughout. Inside, you’ll find bright open living spaces with hardwood floors, granite countertops, and stainless-steel appliances that make cooking and entertaining a joy. The home offers five bedrooms and five and a half bathrooms, ensuring every guest will have plenty of room and privacy to unwind after a day of sun and sand. Step outside to enjoy multiple balconies perfect for morning coffee or sunset cocktails, and a private backyard oasis complete with a pool, grill, and outdoor dining area for relaxing evenings under the stars. With on-site parking for three vehicles and six complimentary adult bikes, exploring the scenic path along 30A is easy and fun. A nearby tram stop also provides convenient beach access through the Villas at Sunset Beach. Whether you’re here to soak up the sun, explore local shops and restaurants, or simply unwind by the pool, Barefoot on 30a offers everything you need for a memorable 30A getaway. HOME HIGHLIGHTS: -6 Adult Bikes -Private Heated Pool **Pool heating available for an additional fee/$50** -Resort Style Community Pool -Balconies with Views on Every Floor -Outdoor Dining and Sitting Areas -Smart TVs -Gas Grill -Beach Gear -Beach Tram Stop Across from home -Outdoor Shower -3 Dedicated Parking Spots with Additional Parking Available Throughout the Community ACCOMMODATIONS: Sleeps: 13 5 Bedrooms / 5.5 Baths FIRST FLOOR: -Bedroom 1: King Bed with Private Ensuite. -Half Bath SECOND FLOOR: -Bedroom 2: (5) Twin Beds (Built in Bunks) with Ensuite. -Bedroom 3: King Bed with Ensuite. -Bedroom 4: King Bed with Ensuite. THIRD FLOOR: -Bedroom 5: King Bed with Ensuite. -Kitchenette & Living Room. **WHAT WE OFFER** A STARTER SUPPLY OF PREMIUM AMENITIES: Body Wash | Shampoo | Conditioner | Hand Soap | Toilet Paper | Dish Soap | Dishwasher Pods | Laundry Detergent | Paper Towels | Trash Bags | Dish Sponge | Bath Towels | Bed Linens | WELCOME BUNDLE: Coffee Grounds | 2 Keurig Pods | Popcorn | Olive Oil | Fiji Water PARKING Three parking spaces available. Overflow available throughout the community first come first serve. Passes are required which will be provided by Seacrest security. Included are 6 bicycles (adult) for your convenience. SEACREST BEACH COMMUNITY HIGHLIGHTS: Seacrest Beach is one of the charming coastal communities that sits on 30A nestled between Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach. Within the Seacrest community, there is a private beach and just 2 blocks away is the largest resort style family-friendly pool in Northern Florida with over 12,000 square feet of crystal-clear water. When you re ready to take a break from the pool and beach be sure to visit Peddlers Pavilion. Peddlers Pavilion is located in Seacrest Beach and is a collection of fun and unique businesses. Here you will find boutiques offering coastal attire to handmade jewelry. There are also some great local spots for dining. For additional entertainment shopping, dining and local events, take the Scenic 30A bike path to nearby Rosemary Beach, Florida. **Please Note:** *Seacrest Beach does not allow golf cart rentals. AMENITY ACCESS In order to park and have access to Seacrest Beach amenities, guests are required to complete the online Seacrest Beach HOA Guest Registration packet, prior to their arrival. A link will be sent after the reservation is made. Upon arrival, you can pick up your parking passes and wristbands at the Guest Service Window by the lagoon pool. Guests can enter the lagoon area amenity complex at any of the six gates. There will be a queue outside of the Guest Services office marked by safety yellow beach umbrellas. BEACH ACCESS Seacrest Beach community features a private beach on the south side of 30A. There are tram stops though out the community that operate on demand. Upon entering the beach to the left (east), there is onsite chair rental service. La Dolce Vita is the exclusive provider at Seacrest Beach. Guests may bring their own chairs to the beach for set up on the right (west) side of the beach. Prohibited items at the private beach access: wagons, wheeled coolers, tents, and canopies. HOUSE RULES *Check-In: After 4PM | Check-Out: Before 10AM *Must be 25 years of age to book. Guests under 25 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian that is staying on premises. *No Smoking: Smoking is strictly prohibited including back porch/deck. *No parties or events. *During busier times and due to limited infrastructure, internet connectivity may be affected. No refunds will be given for connection issues no wifi, or slow wifi. *Capacity for 3 vehicles in the driveway. *Home must remain pet free. IMPORTANT PRIOR TO ARRIVAL All guests will be required to sign a rental agreement, as well as provide a valid ID that matches with the name of the person that made the reservation which includes: 1) a photo of your government issued ID such as a driver s license and 2) a "selfie". Other things to note
